```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/tools.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
section = data.get("section", {})
resources = data.get("resources", [])

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def render_resource(resource):
    title = safe(resource.get("title"))
    category = safe(resource.get("category"))
    language = safe(resource.get("language"))
    description = safe(resource.get("description"))
    url = safe(resource.get("url"))
    button = safe(resource.get("button_label", "View Resource"))

    return f"""
    <article class="cw-tool-card"
             data-category="{category}">

      <div class="cw-tool-card-top">
        <span class="cw-tool-category">{category}</span>
        <span class="cw-tool-language">{language}</span>
      </div>

      <h3>{title}</h3>

      <p class="cw-tool-description">{description}</p>

      <div class="cw-tool-card-footer">
        <a href="{url}"
           class="cw-tool-button"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener noreferrer">
          {button} <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
      </div>

    </article>
    """

categories = sorted({
    str(r.get("category"))
    for r in resources
    if r.get("category")
})

category_options = "".join(
    f'<option value="{safe(c)}">{safe(c)}</option>'
    for c in categories
)

cards = "".join(render_resource(r) for r in resources)

html = f"""
<div class="cw-tools">

  <section class="cw-tools-hero">
    <div class="cw-tools-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-tools-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="cw-tools-directory">

    <div class="cw-tools-section-heading">
      <span class="cw-tools-section-label">
        {safe(section.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(section.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(section.get("description"))}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-tools-toolbar">

      <div class="cw-tools-search">
        <label for="toolSearch">Search tools</label>
        <input
          id="toolSearch"
          type="search"
          placeholder="Search software, packages, or descriptions..."
        >
      </div>

      <div class="cw-tools-filter">
        <label for="toolCategory">Category</label>
        <select id="toolCategory">
          <option value="All">All categories</option>
          {category_options}
        </select>
      </div>

      <button id="resetTools" class="cw-tools-reset"
              type="button">
        Reset filters
      </button>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-tools-results">
      <span id="toolCount">{len(resources)} resources</span>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-tools-grid" id="toolGrid">
      {cards}
    </div>

    <p id="toolsEmpty" class="cw-tools-empty" hidden>
      No resources match your search.
    </p>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const search = document.getElementById("toolSearch");
  const category = document.getElementById("toolCategory");
  const reset = document.getElementById("resetTools");
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".cw-tool-card");
  const count = document.getElementById("toolCount");
  const empty = document.getElementById("toolsEmpty");

  if (!search || !category || !reset) return;

  function filterTools() {

    const query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const selected = category.value;

    let visible = 0;

    cards.forEach(card => {

      const matchesSearch =
        card.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query);

      const matchesCategory =
        selected === "All" ||
        card.dataset.category === selected;

      const show = matchesSearch && matchesCategory;

      card.hidden = !show;

      if (show) visible++;

    });

    count.textContent =
      `${visible} of ${cards.length} resources`;

    empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
  }

  search.addEventListener("input", filterTools);
  category.addEventListener("change", filterTools);

  reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    search.value = "";
    category.value = "All";
    filterTools();
  });

  filterTools();

});
</script>
